identity_derivations.reason: Runtime profile ID derives from every closed preimage field; exact observed and derived examples below use the native canonical projection algorithm.

state_transitions.reason: Human implementation authorization remains separate from independent certification and native readiness.

items.condition: Separate independent PROTECTED certificate binds the exact prompt/spec raw bytes, all twelve lenses PASS, no unresolved decisions, implementability PASS.
Native IMPLEMENTATION_READY with the independent certificate followed by Karl explicit implementation authorization; never infer deployment or login authority.
Exactly sixteen declared files and mandatory local/full/exact-head CI evidence; no production installation or provider/account operation.

failure_precedence.reason: Use unchanged repository-native readiness-failure order; runtime decision failures are sanitized, local-only and never provide authority.

examples.reason: Both canonical IDs are deterministically verified examples, not implementation/production PASS receipts. Windows is observed; Linux is an explicit derived target.

evidence_plan.reason: Planned new nodes belong to exact in-scope test files; implementation must create them with real assertions and record actual counts.

items.expected_result: One changed requirement, lock byte, Python version, platform, package version, missing/extra/duplicate inventory or forged original pin blocks before child launch; valid manifest hash deterministic.

Windows sealed 68-distribution candidate: exactly 17 observed default-control names, zero explicit tools, lazy installations forbidden, subprocess installer attempts denied, socket targets denied, and identical approved 68-distribution inventory before/after. The 83-distribution drift and earlier pre-probe audit are not admissible. No old-pin PASS; Linux control/tool count unobserved and separately gated.
Offline fake-wire child verifies profile before launch and binds exact profile to canonical request, captured wire and origin; mismatch never dispatches.

Synthetic valid RS256 accepted; wrong algorithm/key/issuer/audience/nonce/claims, malformed/deep header, oversized token/JWKS and reused options rejected without echo; actual child parsing path exercised.

Profile required for mock preflight and dispatch-origin classification; missing/stale/forged profiles fail before credential access or mocked HTTP dispatch; sterile children disable Hermes lazy installs and offline subprocess package installation.
Profile survives provenance hashing and verification; old evidence cannot be relabelled, and unchanged no-economic preview semantics remain.

Frozen lock and installed inventory match per-platform policy; Pillow decode/convert/save and JPEG thumbnail smoke checks, dependency consistency, matching audit and explicit PyJWT options-regression evidence retained.

items.command: Run exact readiness --check-diff, final full local suite, applicable security checks and one exact-head hosted CI plan as specified in prompt.
